problem_text:
A regional telecommunications company must dispatch a technician to inspect nine critical network nodes.

The latency durations between nodes are measured in milliseconds:
* Node 1 to Node 2: 89.9 ms
* Node 1 to Node 3: 102.9 ms
* Node 1 to Node 4: 57.1 ms
* Node 1 to Node 5: 30.9 ms
* Node 1 to Node 6: 93.5 ms
* Node 1 to Node 7: 120.4 ms
* Node 1 to Node 8: 111.2 ms
* Node 1 to Node 9: 88.6 ms
* Node 2 to Node 3: 107.0 ms
* Node 2 to Node 4: 84.5 ms
* Node 2 to Node 5: 115.8 ms
* Node 2 to Node 6: 12.4 ms
* Node 2 to Node 7: 175.6 ms
* Node 2 to Node 8: 181.4 ms
* Node 2 to Node 9: 77.0 ms
* Node 3 to Node 4: 147.8 ms
* Node 3 to Node 5: 99.5 ms
* Node 3 to Node 6: 119.0 ms
* Node 3 to Node 7: 87.6 ms
* Node 3 to Node 8: 109.8 ms
* Node 3 to Node 9: 30.1 ms
* Node 4 to Node 5: 85.6 ms
* Node 4 to Node 6: 80.1 ms
* Node 4 to Node 7: 177.5 ms
* Node 4 to Node 8: 167.1 ms
* Node 4 to Node 9: 125.3 ms
* Node 5 to Node 6: 121.1 ms
* Node 5 to Node 7: 94.8 ms
* Node 5 to Node 8: 81.5 ms
* Node 5 to Node 9: 94.3 ms
* Node 6 to Node 7: 185.5 ms
* Node 6 to Node 8: 189.9 ms
* Node 6 to Node 9: 89.1 ms
* Node 7 to Node 8: 33.8 ms
* Node 7 to Node 9: 110.0 ms
* Node 8 to Node 9: 126.2 ms

The objective is to determine the minimal cumulative latency inspection circuit, where the technician must visit every node precisely once before concluding at the initial node.
